en: The image depicts an old black-and-white or sepia-toned photograph of two large, elegant buildings by the side of a pond or small lake, with a fountain in the water. There are several trees and a bench in the foreground, and the area appears to be a park or garden. Mist or fog is visible in the background, with a forested hillside behind the buildings. The text at the top reads: 'Sundsvall. Parti från Bünsovska tjärn.'
